description: Agent cost and throughput parameters, pessimistic tier. See paper/main.tex tab:scenario:agents. A deliberate stress case rather than an observed price point, the counterpart of the very high project tier: the capability of the low tier (Claude Sonnet 5, the weakest we model) at ten times the cost of the high tier (Claude Fable 5, the most expensive). It exists because both halves of the agent grounding are optimistic - the SWE-bench Verified scores likely overestimate real capability, and the cost estimates assume today's API prices and today's token consumption per work item. Every non-cost field is therefore copied verbatim from agent_low.json and only c_token is changed, to 10x agent_high.json. c_token is indexed by agent role 1-8 and is a cost per unit of that role's throughput rate; roles 4-6 (Refactoring, Code Review, Security Audit) have no countable unit of output, so r_k = 1 and c_token is a flat fee per deployed instance per sprint. r_refactor is denominated in D_tech units, not in work items.
